acceptance: A fixed closure whose acceptance command performs a nested backlog update completes without deadlock, records acceptance evidence, and writes both entries.
acceptance_cmd: uv run --no-project --python 3.13 --with pytest pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider ops/tests/test_backlog.py -k update_acceptance_can_use_a_backlog_writer_without_store_deadlock
brief: Backlog closure acceptance can deadlock when its proof exercises another backlog writer.
contract_evidence: RED observed: update --commit held backlog store lock while acceptance nested campaign/backlog writer waited; implementation and regression now green.
detail: The fixed-ticket acceptance gate currently runs while backlog.py holds the whole-store lock. Any acceptance command that invokes campaign admission or another backlog mutation waits on that same lock until the gate timeout, so a valid closure can stall and never produce a receipt. Run acceptance under only the target entry lock, then reacquire the store lock for final snapshot validation and write; preserve the same behavior for update and verify closure paths.
plan: 1. Add a narrow per-entry acceptance lock seam. 2. Run fixed closure acceptance outside the whole-store lock. 3. Reacquire the normal store and entry locks for the final write. 4. Preserve acceptance evidence in the final JSON payload and cover nested backlog writers.
